pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Crisp's 2026 plans are Free ($0, 2 seats), Mini ($45, 4 seats), Essentials ($95, 10 seats), and Plus ($295, 20 seats, then $10 per extra seat), each priced per workspace per month… AI credit allowance… $5 on Mini, $25 on Essentials, $75 on Plus"

plans.name: Essentials
plans.quota: 10 seats, $25 AI credits, knowledge base and chatbot builder

nl.tagline: Franse klantcontactsuite met AI-agent Hugo, prijs per werkruimte
nl.description: Crisp, uit Frankrijk, bundelt livechat, e-mail, social en een helpcenter in één inbox, met de AI-agent Hugo voor automatische antwoorden. Je betaalt per werkruimte in plaats van per medewerker, wat voordelig is voor teams.
bestFor: Teams die niet per seat willen betalen
notFor: Wie de kennisbank en chatbotbouwer op het goedkoopste plan nodig heeft
limitations: Kennisbank en chatbotbouwer pas vanaf Essentials ($95/maand)

en.tagline: French customer messaging suite with the Hugo AI agent, priced per workspace
en.description: France-based Crisp bundles live chat, email, social and a help center in one inbox, with Hugo, an AI agent for automatic replies. You pay per workspace rather than per agent, which suits teams.
bestFor: Teams that don't want per-seat pricing
People who prefer a European provider
notFor: Needing the knowledge base and bot builder on the cheapest plan
limitations: Knowledge base and bot builder start at Essentials ($95/month)
